@file:about.js.也能開搜尋，但在 Windows 鍵盤上它常是切換輸入法的快速鍵，不一定有效: Also opens Search, but on a Windows keyboard it is often the shortcut for switching the input method, so it may not work
@file:about.js.關閉視窗（瀏覽器可能先攔走；也可以按視窗右上角的 ✕）: Close the window (the browser may catch it first; you can also click the ✕ at the top right of the window)
@file:about.js.新視窗（檔案總管、終端機），Codex 的新對話，記事本的新索引標籤: New window (File Explorer, Terminal), a new chat in Codex, or a new tab in Notepad
@file:about.js.關閉選單、搜尋、對話框，或取消拖曳: Close menus, Search and dialogs, or cancel a drag
@file:about.js.Enter 開啟 Backspace 或 Alt+← 上一頁 Alt+→ 下一頁: Enter Open; Backspace or Alt+← Back; Alt+→ Forward; Alt+↑ Up one level; Ctrl+A Select all
@file:about.js.F2 重新命名 Delete 移到資源回收筒 Ctrl+Shift+N 新增資料: F2 Rename; Delete Move to Recycle Bin; Ctrl+Shift+N New folder; Ctrl+C / X / V Copy, cut, paste
@file:about.js.Ctrl+C 中斷（有選取文字時是複製） Ctrl+V 貼上 Ctrl+L 清畫: Ctrl+C Interrupt (Copy when text is selected); Ctrl+V Paste; Ctrl+L Clear the screen; Tab Complete; ↑ / ↓ Browse earlier commands; Esc Clear this line; Home / End Jump to the start or end of the line
@file:about.js.Ctrl+W、Ctrl+T、Ctrl+N 是瀏覽器的快速鍵，可能被瀏覽器先拿去用: Ctrl+W, Ctrl+T and Ctrl+N are browser shortcuts, and the browser may take them first. If nothing happens, use the buttons at the top right of the window or the menu instead. Ctrl+Space often switches the input method on Windows, so please click the “Search” box on the taskbar. In the terminal, the Ctrl key only does the terminal's own jobs and doesn't trigger other shortcuts.
@file:about.js.列出資料夾裡有什麼（Mode 欄的 d 代表資料夾，Name 欄是名字）: List what is in a folder (a d in the Mode column means a folder; the Name column is the name)
@file:about.js.換到另一個資料夾（cd .. 往外一層，cd ~ 回到「社區」，也就是家目錄 C: Move to another folder (cd .. goes out one level, cd ~ returns to the “neighborhood”, which is your home folder C:\Users\an)
@file:about.js.複製檔案（複製資料夾要加 -Recurse）: Copy files (add -Recurse to copy a folder)
@file:about.js.刪除檔案，不會進資源回收筒（刪資料夾要加 -Recurse），請小心: Delete files without sending them to the Recycle Bin (add -Recurse to delete a folder). Be careful
@file:about.js.解開 .zip 壓縮檔（x 解開、v 列出、f 指定檔案）。Windows 沒有: Extract a .zip archive (x extracts, v lists, f names the file). Windows has no unzip
@file:about.js.用檔案總管打開目前的資料夾（explorer 檔案路徑 也可以；start、ii: Open the current folder in File Explorer (explorer followed by a path also works; start and ii work too)
@file:about.js.用 Visual Studio Code 打開目前的資料夾: Open the current folder in Visual Studio Code
